messages:
Alice Chen: FYI vendors pushed updated delivery notes this AM. Key points: H100/H200 parts have a minor firmware hold (~3 week delay for some SKUs), B200 availability unchanged, MI300 OEM channel leaning late-Oct GA, and Gaudi lab images arrived early. We need a quick alignment on (1) marketplace embargo staging, (2) cert lab throughput and prioritization, and (3) which hardware SKUs we show as GA vs "preview". My suggestion: stagger embargo lifts per region 2024-10-15 -> 2024-10-29 (EMEA then NA then APAC). Thoughts?

Mateo Rivera: Dropping in — can someone attach the vendor change log? I want to validate which H200 firmware bits are blocking. If H200 slips we should plan a Dedicated canary route for a handful of customers using B200 fallback.

Priya Kapoor: Important: an early adopter customer has a go-live target 2024-10-20. If marketplace listing is public before 10/21 that could surface stuff too early. Proposed compromise: enable marketplace preview for partner accounts 10/15, hold public banners until 10/22. This lets Dedicated customers validate.

Dan O'Neill: Lab QA update: PXN lab capacity = 12 image slots/week. Current backlog: H200=8, MI300=5, Gaudi=3. If MI300 goes late-Oct we can concentrate MI300 runs into two intense weeks but H200 certs will slide. I can free up 4 slots by pausing non-critical smoke tests for two weeks.

Ravi Singh: I'm on a call with the vendors at 2pm. My asks: a 7-day partner-preview build from NVIDIA so we can run Dedicated canaries before public embargo; earlier Gaudi test pods for marketplace smoke; and a clear mapping of vendor device IDs so our image naming won't break. I'll push for commitments today.

Mateo Rivera: If we accept partner-preview builds we need a fallback matrix doc mapping: H200 -> B200 quantized profile-x, MI300 -> MiGPU-lite, Gaudi -> Gaudi-compat-legacy. Recommend a 2-week fallback policy to avoid churn. I'll start the matrix.

Priya Kapoor: Marketing needs an embargo decision by EOD Friday to finalize PR and marketplace banners. If vendors can't give a narrow window, PR gets pushed. Please escalate if needed.

Dan O'Neill: Practical plan: If Ravi secures a vendor preview by 2024-10-10 I can slot MI300 runs week of 2024-10-21 using the 4 freed slots. Without preview cutoff we shift MI300 heavy testing to week of 2024-10-28.

Ravi Singh: Noted. Also flag: some vendor SKUs present different PCI device IDs which break our image tag normalization. Need eng-runtime to allow tolerant tag patterns or we need a pre-processing step in marketplace image builder.

Alice Chen: Clear actions: (1) Mateo 024-10-08 00fallback mapping doc, (2) Dan 024-10-09 00lab replan + capacity sheet, (3) Ravi 024-10-10 00vendor preview ask + device ID confirmation, (4) Priya 024-10-08 00hold PR calendar and provide tentative public listing 10/22. release-bot please create calendar block for "Vendor Embargo Review" on 2024-10-11 10:00 PT.

release-bot: Created event "Vendor Embargo Review" on 2024-10-11 10:00 PT. Invited: Alice Chen, Mateo Rivera, Priya Kapoor, Dan O'Neill, Ravi Singh.

Mateo Rivera: I'll start drafting the fallback matrix and ping eng-runtime about tolerant image tags.

Priya Kapoor: Will freeze marketing assets until we confirm embargo window. :thumbsup:

Dan O'Neill: I'll upload the lab capacity sheet to #eng-infra and tag this thread when ready.

Ravi Singh: Will update here with vendor response by EOD 2024-10-10. If vendors decline partner preview, we move to the 10/28 heavy-run fallback and update marketing timelines.
